title: Generated exact vector resources
objective: Provide generated owned FLINT-backed exact integer and rational vector resource primitives with canonical byte-region construction, lifecycle, serialization, structural arithmetic, dot products, and sanitizer-backed direct tests without public vector integration
references: Existing Sage.js fmpz_mat/fmpq_mat generated resource ABI

handoff.summary: Added distinct generated FmpzVector and FmpqVector owned resources backed by one-column FLINT matrices, with canonical byte-region construction, deterministic close and retained-memory accounting, entry mutation and export, copy, equality, add/subtract, scalar multiplication, dot products, stable serialization, generated host adapters, and direct ASan/UBSan/LSan lifecycle coverage. No public Vector or Matrix integration and no algorithm-specific N-API were added.
risks: The declarations are marked wasm-capable and use host-neutral FLINT headers, but this lane directly validated the generated Node adapter and C ABI rather than rebuilding a WASM FLINT host.
The shared generated FLINT declaration files overlap the concurrent exact-matrix-pivot-ffi-v1 integration lane and must be regenerated once after both authoritative declaration changes are combined.
next_steps: Integrate this authoritative declaration and header after coordinating with exact-matrix-pivot-ffi-v1, then regenerate the shared JSON, safe Python mirrors, host adapter, and native-boundary inventory once.
Add public exact Vector construction and operations in a separate lane after the generated resource foundation lands.
Exercise the same resource declarations through the WASM FLINT lowering when that builder is available.
